args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Brightline Freight's latest issue covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026."
- Article (blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece (insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion, subscriber access via code SUB-4335): Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
